issue_request: FHIR-15023 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request to clean up the doctor-to-doctor Appointment example for a meeting about a patient where the patient is not present; the resolution specifically noted that the example should not be a walk-in appointment and should be more realistic.
initial_application: Git commit 162ff70abb76ded31d0552c589956802ea0d7f38 applied the main source change by changing appointment-example2doctors.xml from a WALKIN/MRI example to a FOLLOWUP/ultrasound example, but it did not update the active examples list description.
additional_context: Appointment is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/appointment/list-Appointment-examples.xml is the active examples-list source for Appointment/2docs. FHIR-14804 is background because it first relied on this example to show an appointment between practitioners about a patient; FHIR-22696 later changed this use case to use Appointment.subject for the patient and practitioner participants only. Current source already reflects that later subject/participant model.
